name: Run AI agent

inputs.name: goal
inputs.label: Goal
inputs.description: What the agent should achieve, e.g. the customer email to handle. Shown when: `{"goal_file": [""]}`

inputs.name: goal_file
inputs.label: Goal file
inputs.description: A text file holding the goal, read as UTF-8 when the step runs (at most 1 MB). Example: `Inbox/request.txt`; Shown when: `{"goal": [""]}`

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.label: Instructions
inputs.default: You are a careful business assistant. Use the tools to act; never invent results.
inputs.description: Role, policy and rules for the agent.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.label: Tools
inputs.description: Ids of the agents it may call, e.g. ["lookup_order", "check_refund_policy"].

inputs.name: forms
inputs.label: Forms
inputs.description: Forms from the form designer the agent may show to the person at the runner, as tools, to ask for information or a decision (attended runners). Example: `["Forms/Approve refund.form.json"]`

inputs.name: form_timeout_seconds
inputs.label: Form timeout (seconds)
inputs.description: How long a form waits for the person; no answer is reported to the agent as not answered. Range: 10 to 86400

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Connection
inputs.description: Name of a Model Connection (provider, model and key managed in one place). Leave empty to set them on this action.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Provider
inputs.description: Who runs the model: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), Hugging Face (its router or your own TGI server), AWS SageMaker (a model on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint), AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI (Gemini). One of: `openai`, `azure_openai`, `anthropic`, `openai_compatible`, `huggingface`, `aws_bedrock_sagemaker`, `aws_bedrock`, `google_vertex`

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Model name; the deployment name for Azure OpenAI; the endpoint name for AWS SageMaker; the model or inference profile id for AWS Bedrock.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.label: API key
inputs.description: API key or access token from the vault (not needed for some self-hosted endpoints). For AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker: the AWS secret access key (or ACCESS_KEY_ID:SECRET). For Google Vertex AI: a service-account JSON key or an access token.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.label: Endpoint address
inputs.description: Endpoint; required for Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI (https://REGION-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION) and self-hosted models (for a TGI server, e.g. http://tgi-host:8080/v1).

inputs.name: aws_access_key_id
inputs.label: AWS access key ID
inputs.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS access key id from the vault (api_key then holds the secret access key).

inputs.name: aws_region
inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS region, e.g. eu-west-1.

inputs.name: sensitive_tools
inputs.label: Sensitive tools
inputs.description: Agent ids that need a person's approval before each call (e.g. issue_refund).

inputs.name: role
inputs.label: Role
inputs.description: Who the agent acts as; added in front of the instructions. Example: `Accounts payable clerk`

inputs.name: action_plan
inputs.label: Action plan
inputs.description: The order in which to use the tools and when to stop or ask a person, in plain words.

inputs.name: output_fields
inputs.label: Output fields
inputs.description: Values the agent must return, name to description; they come back in outputs. Plain text answer when empty. Example: `{"refund_amount": "amount refunded as a number"}`

inputs.name: allow_cancel
inputs.label: Allow cancel
inputs.description: Let the agent end with status cancelled when the goal should not be pursued (with output fields only).

inputs.name: workspace_folder
inputs.label: Workspace folder
inputs.description: The folder the agent's tools may work in: file paths the model gives agents are kept inside it (one outside is refused), agents with a workspace_folder input receive it, and forms and knowledge indexes must be inside it. Any folder when empty. Example: `Work/claims`

inputs.name: credentials
inputs.label: Credentials
inputs.description: Credentials from the vault the agents it runs may use, by the name of their Credential input. They are handed over directly and never shown to the model. Example: `{"erp_password": "$erpPassword$"}`

inputs.name: toxicity_guardrail
inputs.label: Toxicity guardrail
inputs.description: Check the goal, the model's answers and the arguments it gives tools for toxic language (threats, self-harm, hate, insults, swearing): log records it in the trace; block stops the agent with status blocked. One of: `off`, `log`, `block`

inputs.name: toxicity_level
inputs.label: Toxicity level
inputs.description: From which level the guardrail acts: high only threats, self-harm and hate; medium also insults and explicit content; low also swearing. One of: `low`, `medium`, `high`

inputs.name: blocked_terms
inputs.label: Blocked terms
inputs.description: Your own words or phrases the guardrail treats as high, e.g. competitor names or internal code names.

inputs.name: max_steps
inputs.label: Maximum steps
inputs.description: Maximum model turns. New steps start at 25, room for longer tasks; steps saved before keep their own value (8 when they never set one).

inputs.name: max_tokens_total
inputs.label: Maximum tokens total
inputs.description: Stop when this many tokens have been used.

inputs.name: max_duration_seconds
inputs.label: Maximum duration (seconds)
inputs.description: Stop with limit_reached after this many seconds; no time limit when 0.

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: 0 = consistent, higher = more creative.

inputs.name: mask_pii
inputs.label: Hide personal data
inputs.description: Replace emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs and similar before sending; restored in the answer.

inputs.name: approvers
inputs.label: Approvers
inputs.description: When nobody is at the runner, a sensitive tool's approval goes to the Task inbox of these people (user:NAME or role:NAME, separated by commas). Empty: denied at once. Example: `role:supervisor`

inputs.name: approval_timeout_seconds
inputs.label: Approval timeout (seconds)
inputs.description: How long to wait for an answer in the Task inbox; no answer means no. Range: 30 to 1700

inputs.name: knowledge_indexes
inputs.label: Knowledge indexes
inputs.description: Knowledge indexes (Knowledge Q&A > Build index) the agent searches itself for facts, with a search_knowledge tool. Example: `["Knowledge/policies.kidx"]`

inputs.name: mcp_server_url
inputs.label: Mcp server address (URL)
inputs.description: An MCP server whose tools the agent may use (Streamable HTTP). Example: `https://mcp.example.com/mcp`

inputs.name: mcp_token
inputs.label: Mcp token
inputs.description: The MCP server's bearer token, when it needs one.

inputs.name: mcp_tools
inputs.label: Mcp tools
inputs.description: Which of the server's tools it may use (names); empty: all. Name them in sensitive_tools as mcp:NAME to need approval.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The agent's final answer.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: completed, limit_reached, stopped or blocked (by the toxicity guardrail); with output fields also failed or cancelled, as the agent decided.

outputs.name: outputs
outputs.description: The output fields asked for (empty when none were).

outputs.name: trace
outputs.description: Each model turn and tool call, for review and audit.

outputs.name: tokens
outputs.description: Total tokens used.
